query:
SELECT cp.role::text as "role?"
        FROM comms_channels c
        LEFT JOIN comms_channel_participants cp
            ON cp.channel_id = c.id
            AND cp.user_id = $2
            AND cp.left_at IS NULL
            AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM bots b
                WHERE b.id = $3 AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
            )
        WHERE c.id = $1
